definitions.explanation: The state of being widely known and admired.

examples.japanese: {名声|めいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧。
⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧な{名声|めいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
{名声|めいせい} refers to public fame or renown, typically positive and based on achievement.

FORMS:
⟦{名|めい}→名〜：03969_mei⟧ (name) + ⟦{声|せい}→声：02207_koe⟧ (voice/reputation) - literally "one's name being spoken."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {名声|めいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to gain fame
- {名声|めいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{博|はく}す→博す：noentry⟧: to win widespread fame
- {名声|めいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: highly renowned
- {名声|めいせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to damage one's reputation
- ⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧な{名声|めいせい}: worldwide fame

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧: reputation (general, can be good or bad)
- ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧: honor, distinction
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧: famous (adjective)
- ⟦{知名度|ちめいど}→知名度：13664_chimeido⟧: name recognition, degree of fame
